name: tankforge
description: Modern Battle City | a modern reimagining of the classic top-down arcade tank game.

scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && rm -f dist/tankforge.apk && npx cap sync android
scripts.apk: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug --init-script mirror-repos.init.gradle && mkdir -p ../apk && cp -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../apk/tankforge-debug.apk
scripts.apk:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease --init-script mirror-repos.init.gradle
